mentions.name: Firefly
mentions.description: A programming language for building webapps, with performance as a core goal: the project's own site is written in Firefly, uses hydration, and scores 100% on PageSpeed Insights. The language is largely complete, and work is focused on developer experience, including a language server, a devserver, and essential libraries.
mentions.problem: Speed is not an optional feature on the web — webapps need to be fast.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a programming language for webapps!

https://www.firefly-lang.org/

Speed is not an optional feature on the web. The site above is written in Firefly, uses hydration, and scores 100% on PageSpeed Insights.

The language is largely complete, and we're now working on DX: Got a language server, a devserver, and some essential libraries.
